caption: The drawing shows two ceramic pitchers, rendered in detail with colored pencil or watercolor. The larger pitcher, which dominates the center of the drawing, is depicted with a rounded body and a flared lip, handle on the right, and is decorated with a painted scene. The main scene on the side of the pitcher features a building with an American flag on a dock beside a body of water, with boats and sailing ships visible in the water and mountains in the background. In the foreground, a crowd of people is gathered near the water's edge. Above this scene, an American bald eagle with outstretched wings is perched on a shield decorated with stars and stripes, flanked by greenery. The pitcher is accented with bands of yellow and brown along its rim, handle, and base. In the upper right corner of the drawing, an inset shows the same pitcher from a different angle, displaying additional decorations on its side, including a shell motif with crossed flags and a view of buildings and land. The entire composition is framed within a rectangular border, and the artist's name "Livingstone" is signed in the lower right corner. The background of the illustration is a plain off-white color.
title: Pitcher
